ValidationRule.description: Requires that Closed Lost Category and Reason(s) be chosen when the Opportunity is Lost
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IsPickVal(StageName,"Closed Lost") && OR(ISBLANK(Lost_Reason__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Lost_Category__c))) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6') && CloseDate > DATE(2022,01,01)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If the Opportunity is Lost, Please choose a Lost Category and Reason.
